findings: Header calculation is a 32-bit rolling operation over NUL-terminated UTF16 units; ordinary branch h=129*h+unit modulo2^32.
ASCII uppercase A-Z takes special packed-bit branch; uppercase and lowercase do not simply normalize to the same hash.
Reset enters critical section at object+0x30 and clears two container sentinels plus size fields at object+0x08 and +0x18.
Reset calls context-producing helpers and combines outputs with semicolon literal into object+0x60. Exact context meaning unverified.
Previously observed loader compares loaded dword to this header calculation and resets on mismatch; comparison is not sufficient to prove mtime/content fingerprint.
